description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind/NE magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Lv.2 En-Ice Stack, Lv.2 En-Lightning Stack, Lv.2 En-Water Stack or Lv.2 En-Wind Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Damage +20%, Magic Casting Speed x1.1 & chases an Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind ability with Instant Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind 2 and Instant ATB 2 to user (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Harmonic Displacement+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
